title: Here am I; send me — bolder than Moses
english: After the throne vision Isaiah answers [[Whom shall I send? — Here am I; send me >> Bible:Isaiah 6:8]]. Moses had pleaded [[send someone else >> Bible:Exodus 4:13]]; Isaiah volunteers before he knows the hard word: [[hear and hear, but do not understand >> Bible:Isaiah 6:9]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Isaiah).

title: Why hearing without understanding
english: Why [[see and not perceive; hear and not understand >> Bible:Isaiah 6:9-10]]? A fat heart, dull ears, shut eyes — judgment that still aims at healing when they turn.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Isaiah).

title: Shut eyes from harm; the Word heals
english: Better to [[close the eyes lest we look on evil >> Bible:Isaiah 33:15]] than to drink harmful talk. When we turn to God’s words, he [[sends his word and heals >> Bible:Psalm 107:20]] in Christ Jesus. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Isaiah).
